description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and South Wind Avatar's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, South Wind Avatar's first ability triggers twice.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for each of the South Wind Avatar triggers.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
